linkedin: Exact /collect and /collect/ routes on px.ads.linkedin.com are covered. Modern /wa/ Website Actions sends a separate compressed/base64 protocol and remains recognized without a contract. Alternate hosts are not inferred.

The pinned producer emits comma-separated numeric partner IDs and optional conversion IDs. Version, time, type and GET checks are advisory. Currency, value, tag-manager and browser identities are forwarded values without an inferred receiver schema.
Partner and conversion ownership, matching permissions, deduplication and delivery require external context. Conversions API is a separate pack.
pinterest: Exact /v3 and /v3/ collectors are covered. /user/, /stats/, metadata, configuration and no-code CAPI protocols remain outside this profile.
Browser ed, pd, ad and ov JSON strings are checked in query and form captures. Source event data arrays and custom event names are accepted. Arbitrary custom properties remain open.

SDK partner hashes may be scalar or arrays and retain MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 prehashes, null and empty entries. Noscript enhanced-match fields retain their separate documented SHA-256 grammar. Digest correctness and matching permissions are not established.

Native quantities are integer checked; numeric strings follow the producer numeric profile without asserting full integer coercion. SDK event IDs and product identifiers accept numeric caller values. Missing JSON purchase totals are not borrowed from the noscript bracket requirements.
Producer structure and transport checks are advisory. Configuration ownership, consent decisions, deduplication and delivery remain external.
quora-pixel: Exact /_/ad/{pixel_id}/pixel image callbacks are covered. Pixel identities and custom event names remain opaque. No Conversions API contract is borrowed.
Dwell duration, lifecycle reason, Instant Article marker and GET checks follow the pinned producer and remain advisory. Timer reasons are lifecycle strings, including blur and pagehide, not Booleans.
Caller conversion strings and event IDs remain open. Timestamp freshness, account ownership, matching permissions and delivery require external context.
chartbeat: Exact /ping requests on ping.chartbeat.net are covered. Loader scripts, /ping/mab, custom ping servers and other Chartbeat products remain outside this profile.
Producer counters, viewport metrics, activity flags, capability mask and GET checks are advisory. No unstated metric bounds, future-version restriction or configured-metadata vocabulary is inferred.
Empty external referrers, empty titles, opaque session metadata and cached internal page paths remain valid. Case-distinct fields E/e, R/r, W/w, I/i and L/l remain independent.
Account configuration, page-session continuity, cookie permissions, engagement truth and delivery require external context.

review_notes: All four pinned vendor SDKs executed unmodified in Chromium with every request intercepted. Captures contain synthetic identities and page content only.

Native SDK controls, source-branch mutations and transport boundary fixtures are separate evidence. Existing custom Pinterest event and LinkedIn page-fire expectations were corrected to match producer behavior.
No raw vendor SDK source is redistributed in the product repository. Hash receipts and synthetic fixtures retain reproducible provenance.
